title: Information Geometry of Market Dynamics: A Pareto Frontier from Contact Geometry
description: Reproducibility code for Dean (2026), 'Information Geometry of Market Dynamics: A Pareto Frontier from Contact Geometry'. The paper derives a closed-form algebraic identity, R^2_exact(k, Omega), between the deterministic variance fraction of momentum-acceleration dynamics and the contact-geometric dissipation rate of a stochastic damped harmonic oscillator, with leading-order form R^2 = Omega^2 / (1 + Omega^2). This repository reproduces the seventeen-market cross-market validation (covering Asian, European, emerging-market, and cryptocurrency instruments), the four-way stationary-SDHO consistency battery, the phase-plane flow alignment for SPY, the underdamped-regime candidate sweep (including the Pakistan KSE-100 critical-point result), four numerical verifications of the Pareto frontier theorem, the Sharpe-optimization footnote demonstration, and all paper figures, end-to-end in about three to four minutes on a standard laptop. Code is in Python (NumPy, Pandas, SciPy, Matplotlib, yfinance), with daily price data downloaded at runtime from Yahoo Finance via yfinance.
notes: The six futures markets in the paper's Table 1 are imported from the first companion paper (Dean, SSRN 5990674); the underlying Databento price data are not redistributed. All other empirical results are regenerated end-to-end from freely available Yahoo Finance data via the scripts/reproduce_all.sh entry point.
